clips.title: The story
paras: Talin Keeneye asks for help in Coldridge Valley, where crag boars threaten the trails. The dwarf hunter wants young recruits to thin their numbers so seasoned hunters can track in peace.

Coldridge Valley gives young mountaineers and scholars of Ironforge a quiet, protected place to train. In the harsh winter, its wildlife can grow restless and numerous. Talin Keeneye, a veteran hunter stationed outside Anvilmar, has seen small crag boars multiply across the valley. Their attacks threaten anyone walking the snowy trails.

Hunting gives dwarves meat, hide, and practice in the field. When game grows numerous and attacks on sight, its numbers must be cut. By thinning the crag boars across the valley slopes, young adventurers show they can handle a fight. Their work also gives local hunters room to pursue game without being overwhelmed.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Nothing like a day of boar hunting, eh?

Though, here in Coldridge Valley, there are so many boars it almost takes the fun out of it. No need to get them charging. They're all angry and ready without any help. In fact, recently, there've been so many boars in the area, it's become dangerous for me to do my daily hunting.
Long story short, if you could help me kill some of the boars, I would appreciate it.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Excellent! I can go back to my... Leisurely... Hunting now. Thank you, friend.
